residual_differences_explained_by: operator semantics: Phase 12B mutates aliphatic uppercase element TOKENS (aromatic/charged/bracket atoms immutable, 11 allowed tokens); V2 Simple Substitution re-types any heavy atom including aromatic and attachment-adjacent ones (5 allowed elements)
proposal space: Phase 12B restricts candidates to token-edit-distance <= 3 from the ORIGINAL source and rejects chemical no-ops; V2 restricts to <= 3 operator applications and dedupes canonically

search implementation: Phase 12B greedy scores a fixed 5-neighbour batch and Phase 12B metropolis uses a fixed temperature of 0.1 in eV, but neither charges the source prediction; V2 recomputes neighbourhoods per step and dedupes before spending a query
RNG stream: identical seed value, different random consumption order
